modules.name: core
modules.purpose: HttpClient, retry/error handling, common types, pagination, signed uploads, and the link analytics + statistics types and query helpers shared by short-link and qr-code (4.4.0).

modules.name: short-link
modules.purpose: Short-link CRUD/list client. templateId required; androidUrl/iosUrl and isEnableLandingPage (S13); isEnableMonetization deprecated and stripped from every request; legacy pageinfo.title filter sent as pageInfo.title (4.3.0). getAnalytics(id, query?) and statistics(query?) (4.4.0, VA). Bulk (createMany, export, bulk jobs) since 4.5.0 via core's runLinkBulkCreate/LinkBulkJobApi.

modules.name: qr-code
modules.purpose: Seven QR types with create/update/get/list/delete. Sends qrCodeTarget only; the API builds options.text (free text still sends it). isEnableMonetization deprecated and stripped; isEnableLandingPage on requests and list (4.3.0). getAnalytics(id, query?) and statistics(query?) (4.4.0, VA). Bulk (createMany, export, bulk jobs) since 4.5.0 via core's runLinkBulkCreate/LinkBulkJobApi.

modules.name: social-publisher-workspace
modules.purpose: Workspace CRUD/list and signed logo upload.

modules.name: social-publisher-post
modules.purpose: Video/image publishing, upload orchestration, status and list.

modules.name: store
modules.purpose: Online Store management: products (incl. per-section saves, clone, Excel, AI), orders (incl. dropshipping parts), tags, customers, shipping and dropshipping suppliers. Split into six sub-clients on StoreClient. In the workspace and the publish workflow since 4.3.0.

modules.name: account
modules.purpose: Who an API key is, credits, credit history and summary, live operation prices. New in 4.3.0.

modules.name: mcp
modules.purpose: @posty5/mcp: every SDK service as MCP tools (138 in 10 toolsets), createPosty5McpServer, listTools/listToolsets, and the posty5-mcp stdio binary. Access levels, confirm gate, aiModel attribution, idempotency. New in 1.0.0.

modules.name: webhooks
modules.purpose: @posty5/webhooks: WebhookEndpointClient over /api/webhook-endpoints (CRUD, rotate-secret, test, deliveries, redeliver, event-types) and verifyWebhookSignature (Standard Webhooks, node:crypto, Node only). New in 4.5.0.

modules.name: qr-design
modules.purpose: @posty5/qr-design: framework-free QR design engine. renderDesignSvg (deterministic v2 SVG: shapes, gradients, frames with outlined Latin/Arabic CTA text, print presets), checkScannability (K5), normalizeDesign/isV2Design/encodeMatrix, catalogues. No HTTP, no @posty5/core. New in 4.7.0.
